title: Preserve named-root restart confirmation through a durability-pending launcher replay
outcome: Once a pending first bound registration after restart commits and its exact replay publishes, that publication consumes the valid process-local confirmation for the same naming image.
acceptance: A production registration regression reaches canonical confirmation, forces the first durability wait to time out, then publishes the late commit through identical-request replay and proves the next new name-bound registration does not perform another canonical read.
Replay consumes the confirmation only for the exact pending registration while the same live naming image owns it. Changed, ended and ambiguous authority still require the ordinary checks.
